name: Verifed V28
description: Restores Taco Bell's V25 purple/white menu system and Chipotle's V25 brown/red/white menu styling, typography and uppercase hierarchy without reverting updated menu logic. Returns the dark-green, yellow-card, white-action welcome design from V25; gives authentication its own dark-green composition. Removes the orange period and heavy font weight from the Verifed wordmark throughout the main shell.
verification: Restored brand-specific style definitions from V25 and kept V27 live menu operations, photo assets, saved selections, and accessibility controls.
Welcome retains V26.1 Chipotle image containment and enlarged account/guest text, while restoring V25 green/yellow/white palette.
Checks for chain-specific headings, welcome/auth isolation, unbold wordmarks and distinct color tokens included in regression suite.
iOS/Android/web exports and Expo Snack publish to be run by GitHub Actions; physical-device review not asserted.
